letter_description: The following are multiple choice questions (with answers) about science.
train_view_policy: One view per question per epoch; each question has two original-text and two permuted-letter visits over four epochs. Its two letter visits use 0 and 5 train-only demonstrations.
validation_policy: Both views of every original held-out validation question; fixed permutations and train-only demonstrations; lowest mean token-KL plus 0.1 gold-CE selects checkpoint.
benchmark_policy: Official lm-eval prompts/scoring. Original first-128 OBQA and ARC pilots and the fixed 128-question, 57-subject, 5-shot MMLU pilot. No benchmark question is used for training or checkpoint selection.
